name: dsh-followup-todo
description: DSH plugin: a cross-session follow-up todo list for the human. The agent records items you asked to handle later via todo_add/todo_list/todo_done/todo_archive, each carrying P0-P3 priority plus a structured handoff (context + inject) so a brand-new session can pick it up without re-reading the old conversation. Host persists to ~/.dsh/followup-todos-<workspace>.json and serves /followup-todos HTTP routes for the browser half.
